fields.legacy: legacy file prefixes of this locale (LOCALES[].legacy in src/site.mjs)
fields.sources: legacy files of this locale (blob = git object id); a further file names the one it duplicates and whether it is byte-identical
fields.dir: <html dir> of the legacy page; null = not set (left to right)
fields.title: <title> of the legacy page (also segment head.title)
fields.description: <meta name="description"> of the legacy page (also segment head.description)
fields.alignment:
pairing report against index.html: enOnly = en segments without a counterpart here; structure = element counts per section that differ from index.html (inline elements such as
do not affect pairing)
fields.segments: the page copy in document order (head, header, hero, features, screenshots, cta, faq, footer)
fields.notice: js/site-notice.js strings (service-outage banner, off on the legacy site; already migrated to src/notice.json)
fields.id: stable segment id: <section>[.<n> of a repeated block].<role>[.<n>]; the same id is the same slot in every legacy/<code>.json
fields.kind: title | meta | alt | brand | nav | h1 | p | button | h2 | h3 | li | faq-q | faq-a | link | eyebrow | heading
fields.en:
the index.html segment in the same slot (
kept as \n, inline emphasis as plain text, whitespace collapsed)
fields.target: this locale's text, normalised the same way
fields.aligned: true = slot verified: same structural path with equal sibling counts, same link target and same images in its repeated block; false = paired by section + position only (see note)
fields.note: why a pair is not verified, or other alignment remarks
fields.warnings: known problems: "doc …" entries come from the design docs (doc 08 §1.1 / §8, doc 01 §2.9, doc 04 §5.7); "found at extraction" entries were spotted while building this TM; "claims-lint <rule>" entries are hits of src/data/claims-lint.json patterns for this locale in the text, at extraction time

segments.en:
Effortlessly translate any text on any webpage by swiping, insert sentence-by-sentence translations, and get AI-powered context explanations and pronunciation.
No need to switch apps—improve your vocabulary and reading comprehension as you browse. Supports over 20 language pairs, including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more.
WordByWord is your intelligent assistant for mastering new languages with ease.
segments.target:
在任何網頁中輕鬆劃詞翻譯，逐句插入對照，AI 上下文釋義與發音，告別傳統查詞。
無需切換 App，就能在瀏覽中提升詞彙與閱讀理解。支援超過 20 種語言對，包含中文、日文、韓文等多語互譯。
WordByWord 是你外語學習的智慧助手，助你輕鬆掌握新語言。

segments.en: Q1: How do I use the swipe translation feature?
segments.target: Q1：如何使用劃詞翻譯功能？
warnings: claims-lint selection-translate: "劃詞"

segments.en: Simply swipe a section of text on any webpage with your finger or mouse, and the app will automatically insert the translation below the original sentence. To remove a translation, just swipe left on the translated text.
segments.target: 只需在網頁中用手指右滑一段文字，應用會自動將該句翻譯結果插入原文下方。若想取消翻譯，只需向左滑動譯文即可。
warnings: doc 08 §8.1: "with your finger or mouse" is wrong (C-10); the left swipe that removes a translation is real but must not be mentioned (claims-lint swipe-left)
claims-lint swipe-left: "左滑"

segments.en: Q2: How does double-tap word lookup ensure accurate explanations?
segments.target: Q2：雙擊查詞時如何保證釋義準確？

segments.en: The app sends the word and its surrounding context to the AI backend, prioritizing multi-word phrases and providing the most contextually relevant meaning and examples—so you won't be misled by literal translations.
segments.target: 應用會將單字連同其周邊上下文一併發送至後端 AI 服務，優先辨識多詞片語，並給出最貼合語境的釋義與示例，讓你不再被脫離語境的字面意思誤導。

segments.en: Q3: What are the limitations of the free version?
segments.target: Q3：免費版的使用限制有哪些？

segments.en: The free version allows a limited number of AI translations and 20 AI pronunciations per day. For details, see the in-app introduction. To lift the limits, upgrade to Plus or use native TTS mode.
segments.target: 免費版每日可使用 有限次數的 AI 翻譯與 20 次 AI 發音，具體請查看應用內介紹。超過限制後可選擇升級 Plus 版，或使用本地 TTS 發音模式。
warnings: doc 08 §8.1: wrong quota — "20 AI pronunciations per day" (C-05); quotas are placeholders in the new copy (faq[free] + pricing table)

segments.target: Q4：支援哪些語言之間的互譯？

segments.en: The initial version supports translation and explanation between over 20 languages, including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more. More language pairs will be added in future updates. The app automatically detects the target language and uses the best prompt template for high-quality results.
segments.target: 初始版本支援包含從英語到中文、日文、韓文等超過 20 種語言對的翻譯與釋義；後續版本將陸續新增更多語言對。應用會自動偵測目標語言並調用對應 Prompt 模板，保證翻譯品質。

segments.en: Q5: How can I view my history?
Tap the "History" icon at the bottom of the main screen to view all your translation and lookup records, grouped by date. Swipe left or right to delete individual records or view details.
segments.target: 在主介面底部點擊「歷史」圖示，即可進入 Word History 頁面，依日期分組瀏覽曾經劃詞與查詞的紀錄。可左右滑動刪除單條紀錄，也可查看詳細的上下文與釋義。
